Before you choose

Can I buy a subscription from this preview?
No. No payment or subscription is started on this website. The approved app plan-selection destination still needs to be connected.
Does the monthly equivalent mean monthly billing?
No. The displayed ₹7,999 price is annual. The monthly equivalent explains that annual amount; it is not a monthly payment option.
Are trial or refund conditions confirmed?
No trial or refund conditions have been established for this preview. Review the applicable approved terms when the purchasing destination is available.
